name: Mavarin
source: Mavarin, the Charmareian of Earth. After being pushed around her entire life, she made the decision to leave her people behind. She is revered as a god by the Earthians. Despite her terrible experiences on Planet Charmara, she hopes to return one day. There's someone she has to see again no matter what.
